name: handler_beepr
title: Progression Handler: Progress Reported as 'beepr' Sounds (Audio)

origin.description: Build a progression handler that plays beepr sounds.
origin.usage: handler_beepr(initiate = 2L, update = 10L, finish = 11L, interrupt = 9L, intrusiveness = getOption("progressr.intrusiveness.audio", 5), target = "audio", ...)

arguments.name: initiate, update, finish, interrupt
arguments.text: Sound indices for start, update, completion, and interrupt. NA is silence.

arguments.name: intrusiveness
arguments.text: How disruptive the reporter is. The default reads progressr.intrusiveness.audio, or 5.

arguments.name: target
arguments.text: Where progress is rendered. The default is "audio".

origin.details: The function looks up beepr::beep() before it builds the handler. beepr is not installed, so that lookup stops the call.
origin.value: A function of class progression_handler. On this machine the package lookup stops before that function is returned.
origin.example:
err <- tryCatch(handler_beepr(), error = function(e) conditionMessage(e))
cat("handler_beepr() errors: ", err, ".\n", sep = "")

translation.description: Build a progression handler that would play beepr sounds.
translation.usage: handler_beepr(initiate=2, update=10, finish=11, interrupt=9, intrusiveness=None, target="audio", **extra)

arguments.name: initiate, update, finish, interrupt
arguments.text: Sound indices for start, update, completion, and interrupt. NA is silence.

arguments.name: intrusiveness
arguments.text: How disruptive the reporter is. The default reads progressr.intrusiveness.audio, or 5.

arguments.name: target
arguments.text: Where progress is rendered. The default is "audio".

translation.details: The call looks up beepr before it builds a handler. That package is not translated, so the call stops with R's missing-package message.
translation.value: A function of class progression_handler. On this machine the package lookup stops before that function is returned.
